consumable_movements_sign_chk.name: consumable_movements_sign_chk
consumable_movements_sign_chk.value: ("consumable_movements"."kind" IN ('receipt', 'transfer_in', 'return') AND "consumable_movements"."delta" > 0) OR ("consumable_movements"."kind" IN ('delivery', 'transfer_out') AND "consumable_movements"."delta" < 0) OR "consumable_movements"."kind" IN ('adjustment', 'reversal')

consumable_movements_recipient_chk.name: consumable_movements_recipient_chk
consumable_movements_recipient_chk.value: ("consumable_movements"."kind" IN ('delivery', 'return') AND (("consumable_movements"."recipient_user_id" IS NULL) <> ("consumable_movements"."recipient_name" IS NULL)) AND ("consumable_movements"."recipient_ref" IS NULL OR "consumable_movements"."recipient_name" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("consumable_movements"."kind" NOT IN ('delivery', 'return') AND "consumable_movements"."recipient_user_id" IS NULL AND "consumable_movements"."recipient_name" IS NULL AND "consumable_movements"."recipient_ref" IS NULL)

consumable_movements_reversal_chk.name: consumable_movements_reversal_chk
consumable_movements_reversal_chk.value: ("consumable_movements"."kind" = 'reversal') = ("consumable_movements"."reverses_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("consumable_movements"."kind" <> 'reversal' OR "consumable_movements"."note" IS NOT NULL)

consumable_movements_transfer_chk.name: consumable_movements_transfer_chk
consumable_movements_transfer_chk.value: "consumable_movements"."kind" NOT IN ('transfer_out', 'transfer_in') OR "consumable_movements"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL

consumable_movements_reason_chk.name: consumable_movements_reason_chk
consumable_movements_reason_chk.value: ("consumable_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "consumable_movements"."reason" IN ('physical_count', 'waste_damage', 'loss', 'other') AND ("consumable_movements"."reason" <> 'other' OR "consumable_movements"."note" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("consumable_movements"."kind" <> 'adjustment' AND "consumable_movements"."reason" IS NULL)
